label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 048 ]

blocks.text: People are often considered to be rude unintentionally. Absorbed in their own thoughts, people do not see the motions of someone trying to greet them. They may walk right by a friend without noticing him or her. Others indeed do not see―they are without their contact lenses or are quite nearsighted. It is important to take into consideration absent-mindedness or poor eyesight before believing that a friend is actually disregarding you. One friendship I know of was tense for months because a woman thought she was being ignored by a friend who simply was not wearing her glasses and couldn’t see beyond her nose. *nearsighted: 근시안의 We should carefully think about the reason someone’s behavior to avoid coming to a hasty conclusion about it.

readingSentences.english: In modern society, time has become one of our most precious commodities.
readingSentences.korean: 현대 사회에서 시간은 우리의 가장 소중한 상품 중 하나가 되었다.

readingSentences.english: We are constantly rushing from one appointment to another.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 끊임없이 한 약속에서 다른 약속으로 서둘러 이동한다.

readingSentences.english: Yet despite all our labor-saving devices, we seem to have less leisure than ever before.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 우리의 온갖 노동 절약 기기들에도 불구하고, 우리는 그 어느 때보다 여유가 적어진 것처럼 보인다.

readingSentences.english: Perhaps true efficiency lies not in doing more things quickly, but in choosing what is truly worth doing.
readingSentences.korean: 어쩌면 진정한 효율성이란 더 많은 일을 빠르게 하는 것이 아니라, 참으로 할 가치가 있는 일을 선택하는 데 있을 것이다.
